name: toolbelt
description: Lists the plugins, skills and MCP servers you have not used lately and that cost tokens every turn (/unused), judged by Claude Code's own counters, and disables or removes them from a pane.

unusedDays.title: Days without use
unusedDays.description: How long a plugin, skill or MCP server goes unused before /unused lists it. A server is listed only once Toolbelt has counted its calls for this long.
